name: modrixcommerce/babylane
description: Baby-store theme matching the reference layout: blue scalloped header, yellow promotion strip, editable campaign mosaic, trending categories, department product panels, detailed shop filters and a complete customer storefront. All pages use the current live section customizer.
author: Modrix team

changelog.notes: The home sidebar list and the Search trending tabs now show product tags (the most-used tags, or the tags you choose in the live editor), linking to the tag's products. Switch either back to its blocks in the section settings.
Uses Admin → Navigation menus (top, departments, mobile, footer) once saved; header and footer get a Menus setting. Reviews and other product modules now follow the description.
The sticky header turns compact while scrolling (logo, search and icons only), with an on/off setting in the live Header section.
Theme-native sticky header on desktop and mobile, with an on/off setting in the live Header section. Announcement banners scroll away; mobile navigation and module actions stay available.
Baby Lane: reference-matched baby-store layouts designed in MagicPath, native section editor, original baby product imagery and real platform shopping flows.
